idea-plugin.name: Process Dump
idea-plugin.description: Writes a Windows minidump (.dmp) of the process attached to a debug session, running or suspended, through dbghelp's MiniDumpWriteDump. Mini (stacks and the memory they reference) or full (all committed memory). Available from the Run menu, the Debug tool window's More menu, and as MCP tools on the IDE's built-in MCP server.

action.description: Write a mini dump (thread stacks and the memory they reference) of the debugged process
Write a full-memory dump of the debugged process
